control_default.description: Runtime control events that do not open or mutate a bridge window lifecycle directly.

bridge_call_default.description: Main-leader may call bridge when frozen semantics/scope are current, no hard stop exists, and no approval is pending.

bridge_window_internal_default.description: Bridge-leader may operate inside the one bridge window named by the accepted packet.

failure_recovery_default.description: Failure, denial, timeout, partial, rejected completion, and orphan facts are persisted even when they block normal progress.

scope_change_requires_approval.description: Changing frozen semantics, frozen scope, success criteria, writable scope, approval requirements, or task/team boundary requires explicit user approval.

hard_stop.description: Unsafe or policy-denied runtime state blocks new bridge calls until explicitly cleared.

default_decision_rules.description: BridgePacket.frozen_scope must match RuntimeSnapshot.scope.frozen unless approval has been recorded.
BridgePacket.frozen_semantics must match RuntimeSnapshot.semantic.frozen unless refresh/approval has been recorded.
No role may terminate or interfere with a process it does not own without explicit authorization.
Pending approval blocks new bridge calls.
Hard stop blocks new bridge calls and scoped mutations.
